name: AD Enumeration
content:
Enumerate the domain {domain} (DC: {dc_ip}).

**Without credentials :**
```bash
# Null session
netexec smb {dc_ip} -u '' -p '' --users
netexec smb {dc_ip} -u '' -p '' --groups

# LDAP anonymous
ldapsearch -x -H ldap://{dc_ip} -b "DC=${domain//./,DC=}"
```

**With credentials :**
```bash
# Users and groups
netexec smb {dc_ip} -u USER -p PASS --users
netexec ldap {dc_ip} -u USER -p PASS -M get-desc-users

# BloodHound collection
bloodhound-python -u USER -p PASS -d {domain} -dc {dc_ip} -c all
```

**Key information :**
- Domain Admins members
- Kerberoastable accounts
- AS-REP roastable accounts
- Machines with unconstrained delegation
- GPOs and ACLs
